title: Senior Human Resources Recruiter
description:
•Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, and other recruitment channels.
  
•Screen resumes and shortlist candidates according to job requirements.
  
•Conduct initial telephonic interviews to assess candidates' skills, experience, and suitability.
  
•Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and clients.
  
•Manage candidate communication, follow-ups, and interview feedback.
  
•Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
  
•Handle multiple job openings and ensure timely closures.
  
•Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**We’re Hiring | Talent Acquisition Specialist**

**Business Thrust Techsoft**
is looking for an experienced
**Talent Acquisition Specialist**
with strong
**IT recruitment and headhunting experience**
to join our team.

**Experience:**
3-5 years

**Industry:**
IT / Technology

**Role:**
Talent Acquisition Specialist

🔹 Key Responsibilities

* Manage the
  **end-to-end recruitment lifecycle**
  from sourcing to onboarding.
* Handle multiple
  **IT & Non-IT hiring requirements**
  across junior, mid, senior, and niche positions.
* Source candidates through
  **LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, job portals, referrals, and professional networks**
  .
* Drive proactive
  **headhunting and passive candidate engagement**
  for specialized roles.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand requirements and manage recruitment priorities.
* Conduct initial screening, interview coordination, follow-ups, and candidate engagement.
* Manage
  **offer negotiations, counteroffers, notice periods, and joining closures**
  .
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for current and future requirements.

🔹 Key Hiring Profiles

**IT:**
Software Developers, QA/Test Engineers, Project Managers, Project Coordinators & Technology Professionals.

**Digital & Business:**
SEO, Digital Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Operations, HR & Finance.

**Leadership:**
Senior, Functional & Business Leadership roles.

🔹 What We’re Looking For

* 3+ years of experience in
  **Talent Acquisition / Recruitment**
  .
* Strong experience in
  **IT hiring and headhunting**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri & other sourcing platforms**
  .
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management & negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple positions and recruitment timelines effectively.
* Experience working with hiring managers and senior leadership is preferred.

🌟 Why Join Business Thrust Techsoft?

Work on diverse technology and business hiring requirements, build expertise in
**sourcing, headhunting, stakeholder management and talent strategy**
, and be part of a growing team.

📩
**Interested?**

📩 Share your CV with Current CTC at: muskan.sharma.businessthrust@gmail.com
